node.title: Rate-half distance-three MDS source-weight reconstruction
node.statement: On the official exceptional-only quotient-distance-three chart, the pair matching, internal slopes xi_i, internal fiber scalars lambda_i, and Theta_2 determine q_bar and every contracted source coefficient explicitly. At a root a in pair i the coefficient is K_a(z-xi_i), while the three canonical coefficients are barycentric. Conversely, once the required 3e external split fibers exist, the reconstructed moment pencil satisfies Mq=0 identically, has the exact exceptional/ordinary ranks, and obeys adj M=c_H z q q^T with the full first-order crossing. The reciprocal square and original column-far lift remain open.
